profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Arm
profile.summary: Experienced software developer passionate about ethical hacking. Skilled in C++, Python and Java.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of the IPSS back-end team, designed, implemented and tested an AWS-based platform used by customers to configure and simulate Arm systems. Improved a CI/CD pipeline in Gitlab by moving pipeline runners to AWS Fargate, allowing multiple jobs to run in parallel.

positions.title: Cyber Security Research Aide
positions.description: Worked under the supervision of a PhD student on testing a timing side-channel for floating-point operations and its implications on neural networks. Analyzed the timing for different multiplications with and without subnormal floating points to conclude whether it's possible to predict the inputs for the operation. Used C to generate a Linux kernel module that would run a neural network. The neural network was used to time operations with different inputs.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Programming · Cybersecurity · Computer Science

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked with a team of interns to design a tool for RTL instrumentation of a Performance Monitoring Unit used for Cycle Accurate Models. The tool was implemented by using Python templates to automate C++ source code generation and simulation testbenches.
Documented the API used for gathering performance data for the Cycle Model.

positions.title: Research Interviewer
positions.description: Collected data from participants through interviewing. Maintained a cordial relationship with participants and delivered the information to the data manager.

positions.title: EPICS High Mentor
positions.description: Motivated high school students to work on their engineering projects, reviewed their projects, led students through the engineering design process, and helped students resolved problems with their designs.

positions.title: News Editor
positions.description: Researched, wrote, and edited news stories to be published in the Puma Press.

educations.schoolName: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering at Arizona State University
W. P. Carey School of Business – Arizona State University

honors.title: Grace Hopper Scholarship Awardee 2017
honors.description: The Grace Hopper Scholarship gave me the amazing opportunity of attending this conference with a group of other ASU students, members of the Women in Computer Science club.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Work with an assigned buddy to define financial goals and how to reach them.
Aid buddy with creation of a budget.
Teach buddy about the importance of credit history and how to improve it.

Translated different programming Raspberry Pi projects from English to Spanish, including Scratch, Python, HTML and CSS projects. Proofread and tested the final translations to make sure the steps work and the instructions are clear.
